perOption.B: Shows nonzero gradients at the start and finish.

transcription:

Which of the following options gives the correct displacement-time graph of the car?

[All options plot displacement / m against time / s and mark $0$, $t$, $2t$ and $3t$. A: initially flat, then curves up to a plateau from $t$ to $2t$, then curves down to zero and levels off before $3t$. B: rises with a nonzero initial slope, is straight from $t$ to $2t$, and bends over while still rising at $3t$. C: rises steeply and flattens to a plateau from $t$ to $2t$, then falls increasingly steeply to zero at $3t$. D: starts flat and steepens, rises in a straight line from $t$ to $2t$, then bends over to a horizontal tangent at $3t$.]
